content:
Arjun: quick callout 1: VantageEdge (reseller) asking for a retro commission override for Q4. They claim they introduced a renewal and expect a 4% retro on $48k ARR. Sales looped legal and partner. Need internal OK before we pay.

Camille: Wait - retro requests are rare. Do we have partner-signed NCA or a written deal registration?

Evan: They attached an email chain showing registration but start date mismatch (10/05 vs our invoice 10/01). Partner says the renewal was informal and Customer confirmed partner involvement.

Nora: Policy fyi: retro commissions require Manager + RevOps approval if >$5k. Also need proof of influence (deal reg + customer note).

Arjun: Rough numbers: ```
Claimed ARR: $48,000
4% retro = $1,920
Threshold for Manager approval: $5,000 -> this is under threshold but still material because records mismatch.
```

FinanceBot: Automated check: partner record mismatch flagged. Please attach deal-registration doc and customer confirmation email. Internal policy: https://intranet.redwood/finance/partner-commissions (internal).

Camille: If docs are messy, propose splitting payment: 50% now pending legal confirmation and 50% after signed attestation from partner + customer confirming date of influence. Also request partner to waive retro for future renewals beyond this case.

Evan: Partner requested quick payment to cover reseller incentive payout. They're asking for 30-day turnaround. If we don't act fast, partner will escalate to CS.

Nora: I'm okay with conditional 50% release if RevOps verifies the registration and we get a customer attestation on company letterhead. RevOps to track in the commission ticket.

RevOps: Will verify docs and confirm by 2498765400. If evidence lines up, we'll process 50% release and put remainder on hold until legal confirms attestation. Need Signed Deal Reg + Customer email + partner invoice.

Arjun: Sounds good. @Evan please upload the three items and add a short note in CRM with "retro-commission-request" tag. We'll proceed with conditional release once RevOps confirms.

Evan: Uploaded docs at 2498765350, CRM note added. Marking thread deal-desk:pending. :thumbsup:

Nora: Thanks everyone. Keep me posted if partner pushes for full immediate payment.
